images.title: File:Piri reis world map 01.jpg
images.description: Map of the world by Ottoman admiral Piri Reis, drawn in 1513. Only part of the original map survives and is held at the Topkapi Museum in Istanbul. The map synthesizes information from many maps, including one drawn by Christopher Columbus of the Caribbean.
categories: Files with Assessments template missing SDC Commons no value quality assessment

vision_review.reason: High-quality, clear scan of the surviving 1513 Piri Reis map fragment on a white background.

rejected_by_review.description: Manuscript Ottoman Atlas, by Pirî Reis. Author's name given on fol. 376b as Raʾīs al-Baḥr Pīrī ibn Muḥammad; author dates preferred by (Walters) cataloger: d. 962 AH / 1555 CE. All images and metadata are provided by the Walters Art Museum, Baltimore, Maryland, USA.
